errors.what: patch-html called with --selector flag which is not supported as CLI arg
errors.recovered_by: Created HTML patch file with YAML frontmatter containing selector and action fields

problems_and_friction: The patch-html command does not accept --selector/--action/--fragment as inline CLI flags; the protocol instructions implied that syntax but the actual CLI requires a patch file with YAML frontmatter. This required creating an intermediate file. Otherwise the workflow was straightforward.
